metadata.title: AI Factory | Custom AI Software for Enterprise
metadata.description: We design and build custom AI software for mid-market and enterprise companies. Not a consultancy. Not an agency. An AI factory that delivers production systems.

hero.headline: Your company generates data that nobody is turning into decisions
hero.subheadline: We build custom AI software that turns your operational complexity into competitive advantage. No slides. No abandoned prototypes. Production systems.

problem.title: The real problem isn't technology
problem.subtitle: Most AI initiatives fail before a single line of code is written. These are the patterns we see over and over.
problem.pain1Desc: Your team ran a proof of concept 8 months ago. It worked in demo. It never reached production. The vendor already moved on to another client.
problem.pain2Desc: You have 15 systems that don't talk to each other. The information exists, but extracting a single insight takes three people and two weeks.
problem.pain3Desc: Every quarter that passes without automating critical decisions, your competitors are building advantages that compound exponentially.
problem.pivot: These problems aren't solved with more consulting. They're solved by building.

factory.title: Why a factory, not an agency or a consultancy
factory.subtitle: The model matters. The structure of who helps you determines what they can deliver.
factory.agencyDesc: Sells you a team by the hour. Rotates people. Knowledge is lost between projects. The incentive is to extend the contract, not finish the system.
factory.consultancyDesc: Delivers a 200-page document with recommendations. Your team has to execute. The gap between strategy and code is where projects go to die.
factory.factoryDesc: Diagnoses, designs, builds, and delivers. An integrated team with a repeatable methodology that produces AI systems in production. The deliverable isn't a report. It's working software.

methodology.title: From problem to production system
methodology.subtitle: Four phases. Each with concrete deliverables. No surprises.
methodology.phase1Desc: We map your processes, data, and current systems. We identify where AI generates measurable impact, not where it sounds interesting.
methodology.phase2Desc: Technical architecture, data model, and execution plan. You define scope before committing build budget.
methodology.phase3Desc: Two-week sprints with functional demos. You see real progress, not status reports. Continuous integration with your existing systems.
methodology.phase4Desc: Monitoring, model retraining, and production support. The system improves with every new data point it processes.

capabilities.title: What we build
capabilities.subtitle: We don't do everything. We do four things exceptionally well.
capabilities.cap1Problem: Your team makes 200 operational decisions a day using Excel and experience. 60% are repetitive and predictable.
capabilities.cap1Approach: ML models trained on your historical data that make or recommend decisions with integrated business rules.
capabilities.cap1Impact: 70% reduction in decision time. 95% consistency in applied criteria. Full audit trail for every decision.
capabilities.cap2Problem: Your operation processes thousands of documents per month. Each one requires human reading, manual extraction, and system entry.
capabilities.cap2Approach: NLP and computer vision pipelines that extract, classify, and structure information from any document format.
capabilities.cap2Impact: 20x faster processing. Error rate below 2%. Staff reassigned to higher-value tasks.
capabilities.cap3Problem: Your operational data is spread across 12 systems. Building a report requires manual work and always arrives late.
capabilities.cap3Approach: Unified data layer with predictive models that anticipate problems and suggest actions before you check a dashboard.
capabilities.cap3Impact: Real-time visibility across the full operation. Predictive alerts 48 hours before the problem.
capabilities.cap4Problem: Your team spends hours searching for information in manuals, policies, and internal knowledge bases. Customers expect immediate answers.
capabilities.cap4Approach: AI agents trained on your institutional knowledge that answer complex questions with precision and context.
capabilities.cap4Impact: Immediate response to internal and external queries. 80% reduction in information search time.

diagnosticCta.title: You don't know what you don't know
diagnosticCta.subtitle: In 30 minutes we map the 3 highest-impact opportunities in your operation. No commitment. No sales pitch.

depth.title: Where others see complexity, we see patterns
depth.pattern1Desc: We don't build islands. Every system we deliver connects to your ERP, CRM, and existing tools through robust, bidirectional APIs.
depth.pattern2Title: Models trained on your data, not generic ones
depth.pattern2Desc: Generic models solve 60% of the problem. The value is in the remaining 40%, which requires specific training on your data.
depth.pattern3Desc: The code, the models, and the data are yours. No lock-in. No recurring licenses on what we built for you.

insightsPreview.title: Insights
insightsPreview.subtitle: Technical and operational analysis from our team. No marketing. No clickbait.

footerCta.title: Your next competitive advantage is already in your data

footer.tagline: We design and build custom AI software for companies that compete seriously.

howWeWork.title: How we work
howWeWork.subtitle: A process designed to eliminate risk and deliver results, not to extend contracts.
howWeWork.intro: Every project follows four phases with concrete deliverables, defined timelines, and measurable success criteria. You know exactly what you're getting and when.
howWeWork.phase1What: Complete analysis of your processes, data, and tech stack. We identify 3-5 high-impact opportunities with ROI estimates.
howWeWork.phase1Who: Senior solutions architect + Data scientist. Interviews with your operational and technical teams.
howWeWork.phase1Deliverable: Diagnostic report with opportunity map, preliminary architecture, and roadmap prioritized by impact.
howWeWork.phase2What: Detailed technical architecture, data model, integration specifications, and sprint-by-sprint execution plan.
howWeWork.phase2Who: Full team: architect, ML engineer, data engineer. Co-design sessions with your technical team.
howWeWork.phase2Deliverable: Architecture document, API contracts, data schema, and build timeline with milestones.
howWeWork.phase3What: Iterative development in 2-week sprints. Functional demo at the end of every sprint. Continuous integration with your systems.
howWeWork.phase3Who: Dedicated squad: tech lead, ML engineers, backend/frontend developers, QA.
howWeWork.phase3Deliverable: Working system in staging environment, integrated with your real data and ready for acceptance testing.
howWeWork.phase4What: Production deployment, performance monitoring, model retraining, and ongoing support.
howWeWork.phase4Who: ML operations team. One dedicated point of contact for your team.
howWeWork.phase4Deliverable: Production system with defined SLAs, monitoring dashboards, and continuous improvement plan.

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.thesis1: We founded AI Factory because we saw the same pattern too many times: companies with valuable data, approved budget, and AI projects that never made it to production. The problem wasn't the technology. It was the execution model.
aboutPage.thesis2: We built a factory because manufacturing is different from advising. Our team combines experience in ML engineering, enterprise systems architecture, and production software operations. We don't do strategy without building, or building without strategy.
aboutPage.p1Desc: We don't sell ideas. We sell working systems. If it's not in production, it's not finished.
aboutPage.p2Desc: We say what's hard, what's risky, and what we don't know. We'd rather lose a project than promise what we can't deliver.
aboutPage.p3Desc: Everything we build is yours. Source code, trained models, documentation. If you want to operate internally tomorrow, you can.

contactPage.title: Let's talk about your operation
contactPage.subtitle: Tell us what problem you're trying to solve. We respond within 24 hours with an honest initial assessment.
contactPage.formProblem: Describe the problem you want to solve. Be specific: which process, what volume, what outcome you expect.
contactPage.calendlyTitle: Or book directly with our technical team

diagnosticPage.title: AI Diagnostic
diagnosticPage.subtitle: Answer 8 questions about your operation. Our system identifies where AI can generate measurable impact in your specific company. Results in 3 minutes.
